ingredients.name: Chicken breast or firm tofu, cubed

steps: Heat the olive oil ({olive_oil}) in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion ({onion}) and minced garlic ({garlic}) and sauté until translucent and aromatic, about 3 minutes.
Add the cubed protein ({main_protein}) seasoned with salt ({salt}) and pepper ({black_pepper}), searing on all sides until golden brown.
Reduce heat to medium-low, pour in the heavy cream ({cream}), and gently simmer for 5–7 minutes until the sauce slightly thickens.
Taste and adjust seasoning if needed, then serve hot with your favorite side dish.
